A '''braised toadstool''' is a cooked red [[mushroom]], the simple preparation of the toadstool. It heals {{Hp|2}} but gives the eater {{EffectLink|Poison}} for 30 seconds.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/oven/braised_red_mushroom.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Cooking ===
{{Recipes}}

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating a braised toadstool takes 0.8 seconds, heals {{Hp|2}} and gives Poison I for 0:30.

Obtaining a braised toadstool unlocks [[pickled toadstools]] and [[toadstool stroganoff]], which are made from raw red mushrooms.
